title: A Protocol for the Safehouse
author: Bram Nystrom
blurb: Jude Thornbury, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
